name: aquilla
description: Agentic translation management for Bible and mission content: project status, quality, terminology and traceable changes within your authorized organizations.

interface.shortDescription: Translation project status, quality and approvals
interface.longDescription: Aquilla runs Bible and mission translation projects. Connect it to ask where a project stands, which books or files need attention, and whether key terms are used consistently. Choose the organizations Aquilla can access. It can draft and save changes within your current permissions, with ChatGPT confirmation when required. Human translation validation remains a separate review step.
defaultPrompt: Write a status report on my Aquilla projects
Which files in my project need attention this week?
Check my project for inconsistent key terms
